Assassin / Ninja Attack Reaction (Outsiders). 'Your daggers gain +1{p} this turn.'

ATTACK_REACTION: Played in the reaction step targeting the current attack. The release note confirms this can be played even if you are not currently attacking with a dagger â€” so no target.filter restricting to dagger attacks. The ability simply resolves and applies its effect.

MODIFY_ATTACKS_THIS_TURN: Turn-scoped power modifier (effect_types.py:2201-2227). Reads amount/mod/scope/player/filter. Appends a power_mod hook to the controller's turn_attack_hooks; the engine re-applies hooks to every attack for the rest of the turn (engine.py:1243-1259), compiling the filter per attack. Filter ATTACK_SUBTYPE_IN with subtypes ['Dagger'] matches dagger attacks â€” daggers are WEAPONS which attack as themselves, so combat.attack_card carries the Dagger subtype (condition_types.py:296-316 unions subtypes+types plus from_weapon flag). scope TURN and player SELF (default) give 'your attacks this turn'. Unused hooks expire at end-of-turn clear (engine.py:913).

No printed keywords to author (printed_keywords empty).
